title: Philippines Bank Branch Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily activity from 40 synthetic branches of a fictional Philippine bank into incident and service KPIs, 7-day failed-transaction risk scores, ATM downtime anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Incident-free transaction rate, incidents raised, failed-transaction incidents and PHP value processed for 40 branches in Quezon City, Cebu City, Davao City, Iloilo City and Cagayan de Oro.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to branch-day rows.
The incident-type chart shows which incidents end in failed transactions and which always resolve, such as area power interruptions.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of branch KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which branches should field support watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each branch's probability of a failed-transaction incident in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags ATM downtime outliers per branch, and the forecast projects network-wide incident volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Cash audit compliance, branch control document coverage and pending documents frame the control gaps.
Audit compliance against failed-transaction incidents by branch shows where missed audits and failures move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, branch, incident-type and risk tables only.
show: Cash audit compliance and control coverage
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a branch raises an incident right now?

talking_points: Live branch transaction events land in RAW.LIVE_TRANSACTIONS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs INCIDENT events with an SOP hint and the branch's current risk band, then emails the on-call analyst.
tabs.call_out: From branch incident to ticket in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 13 synthetic incident-handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
